intro: Tourism is Croatia's biggest industry, but it also builds ships and electric supercars.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Millions of visitors come for the coast, islands and old towns; tourism makes up about a fifth of the economy, one of the highest shares in Europe.

chapters.title: Ships and supercars
text: Croatia has a long shipbuilding tradition, and the company Rimac builds electric hypercars near Zagreb. Olive oil, wine and Istrian truffles are prized exports.

keyTerms.meaning: An extremely fast, expensive sports car.
